text: Here's a full four-day program. Screenshot this.
Upper one. Bench press, rows, overhead press, pulldowns, curls, and triceps pushdowns.
Lower one. Squats, Romanian deadlifts, leg extensions, leg curls, and calf raises.
Upper two. Incline dumbbell press, chest-supported rows, lateral raises, pull-ups, and overhead triceps extensions.
Lower two. Leg press, hip thrusts, Bulgarian split squats, seated leg curls, and core.
Three sets each, eight to twelve reps, close to failure. Add a rep every week. Save this.
